claim: A hook that holds interrupts off can lose interrupts while update pace stays in range, so game clock and music run slow; read 'interrupts taken' beside update pace.

evidence.text: A stack wipe under DI lost 6% of the interrupts; interrupts on between rows fixed it.

A turbo limiter running the game frame with interrupts off loses the interrupt a long frame spans; recovered from raster wraps and credited to the limiter (verify, 9 unit cases, control; not on hardware).
